name: Am Tien Cave
kicker: Cave temple above a flooded valley
summary: Climb 205 steps to the cave temple 400 m from the Dinh temple, then look over the valley. The board charges 100,000 đồng for an adult, apart from the 20,000 đồng Hoa Lu temple ticket. A child under 1.3 m pays 30,000 đồng. The ticket line also names Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc.
dotReason: The cave beside the temples, the same morning
getThere: About 400 m from the east gate of the Dinh temple, in xã Trường Yên.
heroCaption: The flooded valley between the cliffs at Am Tien

notice.title: The Hoa Lu temple ticket stops at the gate
notice.body: The board prints Hoa Lu at 20,000 đồng for an adult and Am Tien at 100,000 đồng on a separate line. Paying the temples does not show that the cave is included.

body: The heritage page puts the cave about 400 m from the east gate of đền Đinh Tiên Hoàng, on the same Trường Yên ground as the old capital. Most of the cave sits in a flooded valley. The mouth is on the cliff, up 205 stone steps, and the page compares that mouth to a dragon, which is why people also say hang Rồng. The ticket line adds the name Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc.

Inside, the same page says the cave is both a pagoda, for the Buddha and for Nguyễn Minh Không, and a temple for Dương Vân Nga. It says she lived here late in life, and that Nguyễn Minh Không preached here under the Lý. Walk the stair, then the court against the cliff, then look back at the water in the valley.
Do this with Hoa Lu, on the same morning. The hotline on the ticket line is 0987807965. A gate hour and a minute count beyond the 205 steps were not printed.

figures.caption: The wooden halls against the cliff above the stair
figures.alt: Carved wooden temple halls built against a limestone cliff at Am Tien

gettingThere: Walk from đền Đinh if you are already in the old capital. The heritage page prints about 400 m from the east gate. From Ga Ninh Bình the valley is a ride, and no minute was printed.

legs.heading: From the Dinh temple
legs.body: About 400 m from the east gate, then 205 stone steps. Both figures are on the heritage page.

legs.heading: From Ga Ninh Bình
legs.body: Ride to xã Trường Yên, then walk from the temples. Road minutes were not printed.

closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Board page opened 23 October 2026, a separate line from the Hoa Lu temples. Adult 100,000 đồng. Child under 1.3 m: 30,000 đồng. Hotline 0987807965. The Hoa Lu adult ticket on the same page is 20,000 đồng and does not say it includes this cave.
